description: Use when building a Lightning record page in App Builder or when the page users see is not the one you assigned. Trigger keywords: configure lightning record page, lightning app builder, flexipage, record page assignment, org default vs app default, activate lightning page. NOT for page speed - use admin/lightning-page-performance-tuning. NOT for page layout to Dynamic Forms migration - use admin/dynamic-forms-migration. NOT for related list columns - use admin/related-list-configuration.
inputs: Target object API name, and whether the page is a record page, app page, or Home page
Which Lightning apps the object is reached from, and whether any use console navigation
Record types in play and which profiles should land on which page
Form factors that must be covered — Lightning Experience desktop (Large), the Salesforce mobile app (Small), or both
Existing FlexiPage inventory for the object, from Setup > Lightning App Builder or a Tooling API query
How the page will move between orgs: change set, unlocked package, or sf project deploy start
name: lightning-record-page-configuration
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide — FlexiPage — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_flexipage.htm — source for the `FlexiPageType` enum and its per-value API versions, the `.flexipage` suffix and `flexipages` directory, availability from API 29.0, `sobjectType` being unchangeable once set (API 37.0+), `template` required from API 39.0, the `Region` / `Facet` / `Background` region types, "A Lightning page region can contain up to 100 components", the API 49.0 replacement of `componentInstances` with `itemInstances` and of comma-separated `value` arrays with `valueList`, `identifier` required from API 53.0 with a 120-character maximum, the 10,000-character `ComponentInstanceProperty` value cap, the `UiFormulaRule` / `UiFormulaCriterion` operator set (`EQUAL`, `NE`, `CONTAINS`, `GT`, `GE`, `LT`, `LE`), the supported visibility expressions and their page-type restrictions, "Expressions in component visibility rules can span no more than five fields", `FieldInstance` from API 49.0 with `uiBehavior` and `conditionalFormatRuleset` (API 62.0+), the `PlatformActionList` / `PlatformActionType` values used by Dynamic Actions, and the `Standard.Tab.*` system tab naming (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — ActionOverride — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/actionoverride.htm — source for the org-default mechanism: `ActionOverride` declared exclusively within `CustomObject`, the `actionName` and `ActionOverrideType` enums, `flexipage` limited to the View action in Lightning Experience, and the `formFactor` semantics (`Large` = Lightning Experience desktop, `Small` = Salesforce mobile app, null/absent = Salesforce Classic; API 37.0+) (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — CustomApplication — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_customapplication.htm — source for `actionOverrides` (`AppActionOverride`, Lightning Experience from API 38.0), `profileActionOverrides` (`AppProfileActionOverride`), the full field lists of both subtypes, and the precedence statement quoted in `gotchas.md` Gotcha 2: "When a user invokes the custom app, a matching ProfileActionOverride assignment takes precedence over existing overrides for the record page specified in ActionOverride." Also the source for `navType`, `uiType`, and `formFactors` on the app itself (verified 2026-08-15)

Metadata API Developer Guide — ProfileActionOverride — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_profileactionoverride.htm — source for the `record-home` / `standard-home` values of `pageOrSobjectType` (and for the sample XML on the same page that contradicts them), the rule that `recordType` must be null when `pageOrSobjectType` is `standard-home` and is *required* when `actionName` is `View`, `content` and `type` being read-only, and the type's declaration history (`Profile` in API 39.0–44.0, `CustomApplication` from 39.0 and required from 45.0) (verified 2026-08-15)

Tooling API — FlexiPage — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_tooling.meta/api_tooling/tooling_api_objects_flexipage.htm — source for the audit queries: `EntityDefinitionId` (API 39.0+) as "the name of the standard object or ID of the custom object that the Lightning page is associated with", `SobjectType` deprecated in favour of it, and the restriction that `FullName` and `Metadata` be queried only when the result contains a single record (verified 2026-08-15)

Salesforce sample application, `trailheadapps/dreamhouse-lwc` — https://github.com/trailheadapps/dreamhouse-lwc/blob/main/force-app/main/default/flexipages/Property_Record_Page.flexipage-meta.xml — Salesforce-published reference implementation, used for the real component names and structure quoted in SKILL.md: `flexipage:tabset` with a `tabs` property naming a facet, `flexipage:tab` with `body` / `title` / `active`, `flexipage:fieldSection` with `columns`, `flexipage:column` with `body`, `force:highlightsPanel`, `force:relatedListContainer`, the `Standard.Tab.detail` and `Standard.Tab.relatedLists` titles, `flexipage:recordHomeTemplateDesktop`, and `parentFlexiPage` = `flexipage__default_rec_L` (verified 2026-08-15)

Salesforce sample application, `trailheadapps/ebikes-lwc` — https://github.com/trailheadapps/ebikes-lwc/blob/main/force-app/main/default/flexipages/Product_Record_Page.flexipage-meta.xml — second Salesforce-published record page, used to confirm the tabset/facet shape and the default-template inheritance are the standard pattern rather than one file's quirk (verified 2026-08-15)

Salesforce sample application, `trailheadapps/dreamhouse-lwc` — https://github.com/trailheadapps/dreamhouse-lwc/blob/main/force-app/main/default/applications/Dreamhouse.app-meta.xml — Salesforce-published `CustomApplication` showing app-level `actionOverrides` in their real shape: one override per (page, form factor) pair, `pageOrSobjectType` holding the object API name as `AppActionOverride` documents, `type` `Flexipage`, and the verbatim builder-written comment "Action override created by Lightning App Builder during activation." Quoted in `gotchas.md` Gotcha 3 and `examples.md` Example 1 (verified 2026-08-15)

Salesforce sample application, `trailheadapps/dreamhouse-lwc` — https://github.com/trailheadapps/dreamhouse-lwc/blob/main/force-app/main/default/objects/Property__c/Property__c.object-meta.xml — confirms the capitalisation of `actionName` and `type` values written to `CustomObject` action overrides (`View`, `Default`) (verified 2026-08-15)
Salesforce Well-Architected Overview — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html — pillar definitions applied above
outputs: Activated Lightning record page with a written assignment matrix covering org default, app default, and app + record type + profile
Deployable FlexiPage metadata plus the CustomObject and CustomApplication override fragments that actually carry the assignment
Component visibility filter set expressed as UiFormulaRule criteria with an explicit booleanFilter
Assignment precedence audit naming which rung wins for each user population
Checker script report listing unassigned pages, over-capacity regions, and legacy metadata shapes
